Medical Management
Before treatment is initiated, it is important to diagnose the 
cause of the megaloblastosis correctly. Administration of folate 
corrects megaloblastosis from either folate or vitamin B12 defi-
ciency, but it can mask the neurologic damage of vitamin B12 
deficiency, allowing the nerve damage to progress to the point 
of irreversibility.
